name: Healthcare
description: EHR, claims, clinical ops, population health — HIPAA/GDPR-aligned pipelines
rules: PHI/PII never leaves approved secure zones without de-identification
Every transformation retains an immutable audit trail
Clinical code sets (ICD/SNOMED) versioned; mappings are reversible
Claims and encounter data must pass referential integrity before gold publish
memories: Nightly claims adjudication windows are fixed — late jobs escalate automatically
Patient identity resolution uses enterprise MPI keys, never raw national IDs in gold
